finalText:
Migration's done. Found 12 stragglers, all in repo/service/admin files across accounts, billing, catalog, orders, support, and analytics. Each had the same three calls: get by id, list, and update.

I switched all of them to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, left `cache.query` and `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched since those aren't the database call. `verify.js` passes clean.
